authority_policy.rule: authoritative use is granted exclusively by presence of this exact canonical Skill digest in the external production approval registry; the Skill bytes do not change when authority is granted

causal_transition_policy.attribution_rule: never attribute a next_observed_state delta across intervening Agent actions to the earlier chosen action
causal_transition_policy.direct_state_after: state_after is populated only when no other ai_operation occurs before the next evaluated-camp observation
causal_transition_policy.intervened_observation: after any intervening Agent decision, state_after remains absent and the later observation is stored only as non-causal next_observed_state
causal_transition_policy.terminal_rule: if terminal evidence arrives before a direct observation, state_after remains absent and only the proved terminal event is recorded
